question.question_text: How can you get to the dining table from the Kitchen?

answer_options.text: The dining table is adjacent to the kitchen.
Exit the kitchen through the door into the living room and turn left into the dining table.
Exit the kitchen through the door into the dining table.
Exit the kitchen and turn right. Walk forward into the living room and turn right into the dining table.
Exit the kitchen and turn right. Walk forward into the dining table.
